name: edgar_current_reports
description:
Form 8-K current reports (material events: results, executive changes, acquisitions, agreements) for one company, from the EDGAR submissions file.
Returns {cik, company_name, reports_count, reports: [{accessionNumber, filingDate, reportDate, form, primaryDocument, primaryDocDescription, document_url}]}, newest first; document_url is an SEC viewer link.
Inputs (* required): cik*, start_date and end_date (YYYY-MM-DD, filing-date range), limit (1-200, default 50).
Searches only the recent-filings block of the submissions file. 8-K/A amendments are listed by edgar_amendments; foreign issuers file 6-K (edgar_foreign_issuers).
Example: {"cik": "0000320193", "start_date": "2024-01-01", "limit": 20}

cik.description: Central Index Key (CIK), up to 10 digits
